title: A16Z Games // A16Z Speedrun Community Discord
author: Internet_Treasure
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/y5svcctzjnrd1.png?width=450&format=png&auto=webp&s=e2d214d6cabff36fe6375cbf24fc5f3aa13f4601

Hey Folks, 

  
I created it with the intention of connecting with others in the game space, founders who became A16Z portfolio companies, and those who are trying to just break into the space! Come & join our [A16Z Games Discord Community](https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6HC)

I am trying to connect entrepreneurial game developers together where you can:

* Discuss your game ideas
* Practice pitching
* Get feedback on development/raising
* And network with others!



You can join the A16Z Games // SPEEDRUN Community Discord here: [https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6HC](https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6HC)
